verdict.rationale: A downloadable API spec is a fair question for a payroll SaaS with a developer API program, so the axis applies. ADP's API Central documents API discovery, use-case templates, documentation and code samples, but no evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. Docs and code samples are adjacent developer resources and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
